itineraries.title: WAT & PEACE: 2-DAY CAMBODIA ITINERARY
editorial: Our stay was brief. We spent two days in Siem Reap, the gateway to Angkor Wat and the other temples in the area. Siem Reap has an international airport with direct flights from major Southeast Asian cities.
If we’d had a little more time, we’d have dropped by Phnom Penh—mostly to get a better peek at Cambodian life, which isn’t always evident in touristy Siem Reap.
